address_mapping.method: MZ initial entry offset is matched to the exported entry; its segment is adjusted by the MZ initial CS.

census_limitations: The function sizes are Ghidra metadata spans, not independently decoded byte lengths.
Complement ranges are unclassified, not presumed to be code or data; they require disassembly/reference analysis.
Uninitialized MZ allocation may contain runtime-generated code or data, but has no corresponding file-backed bytes.
This census does not prove that the Ghidra function export is complete or that every function boundary is correct.
Indirect or non-literal call targets are not statically resolved; per-routine call records retain them with a null target.
